# LighTxt 1.6
- Greatly accelerated Parquet filtering and unique-value discovery with more efficient DuckDB queries that avoid redundant scans. - Search and browse distinct values beyond the previous 500-value page, with smooth paging and a memory-bounded cache that makes repeat lookups effectively instant. - Added a polished loading state for Parquet filters and sorts: the existing table fades and becomes noninteractive until the new results are ready. - Fixed Parquet tables changing to “Loading…” when LighTxt moves into the background; loaded snapshots now remain stable while windows are inactive. - Added Reload beside Export for Parquet files. When a file changes on disk, LighTxt asks once whether to reload, respects “Don’t Reload,” and prompts again only for a newer revision. - Strengthened snapshot safety so long-running queries never silently mix data from different on-disk file revisions. - Expanded regression coverage for Parquet paging, caching, cancellation, loading, external changes, and reload workflows.

# LighTxt 1.5.1
- Fixed Markdown tables so long cell content wraps within its column instead of shifting later columns out of alignment. - Improved Markdown table handling for escaped pipes, pipes inside inline code, and unmatched backticks.

# LighTxt 1.5
- Added fast, cancellable export from CSV and Parquet views, with a new toolbar button and CSV, TSV, pipe-delimited, and JSON Lines output. - Made CSV filtering and distinct-value discovery dramatically faster, with a clear animated loading state that blocks stale table interactions while results are being prepared. - Added a deliberate multi-document workflow: multi-select Open, Open in New Window, optional tabs, Previous/Next Document history, Reopen Last Task, and automatic memory cleanup for inactive large documents. - Added bounded content, encoding, and delimiter detection—including TSV and pipe-delimited files—plus Open As overrides and automatic extensions for newly saved documents. - Added crash recovery and safer external-change handling, including one clear Reload / Don’t Reload prompt that respects the choice for each file revision. - Improved Unicode safety, table editing and export reliability, file-change protection, and scrollbar hit targets throughout the editor and table views.

# LighTxt 1.4
- Added a read-only Parquet table viewer with sorting, per-column filters, unique-value selection, summaries, and expandable formatted STRUCT/LIST/MAP values. - Improved JSON and YAML View with click-to-expand, double-click-to-collapse, larger adjustable text, and Find results that visibly highlight and navigate to exact matches without leaving View. - Added a non-destructive Prettify preview for bounded JSON and YAML Edit windows. - Added `.script` support and SQL syntax highlighting for `.sql` files. - Fixed table filter controls so they appear immediately and remain aligned while resizing, reordering, and scrolling.

# LighTxt 1.3.2
- Fixed a faint horizontal divider that could run through CSV filter fields. - Kept column titles, filter controls, active-filter styling, and sort indicators cleanly separated across light and dark appearances, resizing, reordering, and horizontal scrolling.

# LighTxt 1.3.1
- Fixed the CSV table header so column titles and filter controls stay fully visible, aligned, and clickable while scrolling or resizing columns.

# LighTxt 1.3
- Redesigned CSV filters with per-column controls, clear active-filter chips, and one-click reset. - Added a fast unique-value picker with search, exact multi-select, and bounded scanning for large CSV files. - Added right-click row and column actions for inserting and deleting rows or columns, alongside sorting, filtering, and column summaries.

# LighTxt 1.2
LighTxt 1.2 turns CSV View into a more capable large-file data workspace:
- Sort and filter individual columns without loading the entire CSV into memory. - Inspect quick column summaries built from bounded, representative samples. - Add or delete rows and columns with each operation preserved as a single Undo step. - Benefit from reliability and performance improvements throughout sparse CSV indexing and editing.

# LighTxt 1.1
LighTxt 1.1 adds secure automatic updates powered by Sparkle and fixes JSON View search so typing a query remains in the Find field without switching to Edit mode.
This release also includes the large-file JSON, CSV, Markdown, navigation, and presentation improvements completed since LighTxt 1.0.
